prompt:
You are checking which candidate answer correctly answers a question about a SQL database.

Question:
I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH actor_director_collab AS (
    SELECT 
        TRIM(c.PID) as actor_pid,
        TRIM(d.PID) as director_pid,
        COUNT(*) as collab_count
    FROM M_Cast c
    JOIN M_Director d ON TRIM(c.MID) = d.MID
    GROUP BY actor_pid, director_pid
),
actor_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_pid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN director_pid = 'nm0007181' THEN collab_count ELSE 0 END) as yash_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN director_pid != 'nm0007181' THEN collab_count ELSE 0 END) as max_other_count
    FROM actor_director_collab
    GROUP BY actor_pid
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as actor_count
FROM actor_stats
WHERE yash_count > max_other_count

[B]
SQL:
WITH actor_director_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        TRIM(MC.PID) as actor_pid,
        TRIM(MD.PID) as director_pid,
        COUNT(*) as film_count
    FROM M_Cast MC
    JOIN M_Director MD ON TRIM(MC.MID) = MD.MID
    GROUP BY TRIM(MC.PID), TRIM(MD.PID)
),
yash_counts AS (
    SELECT actor_pid, film_count as yash_count
    FROM actor_director_counts
    WHERE director_pid = 'nm0007181'
),
other_counts AS (
    SELECT actor_pid, director_pid, film_count as other_count
    FROM actor_director_counts
    WHERE director_pid != 'nm0007181'
),
max_other_per_actor AS (
    SELECT actor_pid, MAX(other_count) as max_other_count
    FROM other_counts
    GROUP BY actor_pid
),
actors_more_with_yash AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT yc.actor_pid
    FROM yash_counts yc
    JOIN max_other_per_actor mop ON yc.actor_pid = mop.actor_pid
    WHERE mop.max_other_count < yc.yash_count
)
SELECT actor_pid, COUNT(*) as count
FROM actors_more_with_yash
GROUP BY actor_pid
